3. Loop through each index i in the array:
    a. For the current index, calculate the right sum as: total sum - left sum - nums[i].
    b. Compare the left sum and right sum. If they are equal, return the current index.
    c. If not, update the left sum by adding nums[i].
4. If you complete the loop without finding a valid index, return -1.

This procedural structure will help you implement a solution that efficiently finds the leftmost middle index.
